content: {"reviewVerdict":"CHANGES_REQUESTED","reviewerVerdict":"CHANGES_REQUESTED","requestId":"da775f5b-44ce-4004-88a3-8fdb32b88f32","round":1,"findings":[{"id":"immediate-path-denylist-gate","severity":"HIGH","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":21,"title":"Plan's core invariant is unenforceable on the v2 `immediate` path, which the plan never specifies","detail":"§2 states that deferred/hand-off-to-shuttle/wait-for-consent/conditional-clause/ambiguous founder text must all be rejected, and §6 states the chosen design is a complete positive grammar because 'adding reject words sentence by sentence was already defeated by multiple rounds of counterexamples'. §3's structure table describes only two shapes (bare v1, evidence-rich `--request` v2) and §5's acceptance matrix row 1 covers only the three conditional positives plus prefix/suffix wrapping. The plan never describes the third shape that the design actually ships: v2 `trigger.kind: \"immediate\"`. That is the one path where the founder's free text is the SOLE authorization evidence — restart-request.ts:573 forces `verdicts.length === 0` and :775 drops the `pullRequest` binding entirely, and the only other trigger evidence (`mergedCommit`) just has to be any ancestor of target. And restart-request.ts:566-570 exempts exactly that path from the anchored positive grammar `isCurrentRestartAuthorization`; its gate (restart-request.ts:547-562) is an UNANCHORED substring allow-match (`IMMEDIATE_RESTART_REQUEST`) plus the keyword denylist §6 says was rejected. Verified by replaying the frozen regexes plus the elapsed-24h `TIME_LANGUAGE` gate: '先交给班车，然后请重启' (hand to the shuttle — explicitly listed in §2 as must-reject), '如果你觉得需要就现在重启' (delegates the decision to the Lead — the exact misjudgment FLY-2654 exists to prevent; CONDITIONAL_FRAMING catches English `if` but not Chinese 如果…就), '你觉得合适的时候请重启', '等 CI 绿请重启' (CONDITIONAL_FRAMING needs 等…就/再), 'Raya 那边稳定下来请重启', '晚点请重启', '等一下请重启', 'restart now unless Tadashi objects' — all reach ACCEPTED. The plan must either specify an anchored positive grammar for `immediate` (as it does for the conditional kinds), or state plainly that `immediate` is denylist-gated, say why that is acceptable for a path with no PR/verdict evidence, and add an acceptance-matrix row enumerating its counterexamples.","failure_scenario":"A Lead builds a v2 `--request` with trigger.kind=\"immediate\" from the founder message '先交给班车，然后请重启' or '如果你觉得需要就现在重启'. No PR, no review verdict and no QA verdict are required. prepareRestartTicket accepts it, the updater claims it, and the whole fleet is restarted now on the strength of a message that explicitly deferred the action or handed the decision back to the Lead.","findingKey":"immediate-path-denylist-gate"},{"id":"plan-superseded-midflight","severity":"MEDIUM","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":6,"title":"The frozen plan blob was replaced in the working tree during this review round","detail":"The frozen blob 6aed20c (HEAD 39143d02d) is the Part-A-only 'current unconditional instruction' design reviewed here. During this round the working-tree plan.md was rewritten to blob e07d58f4, retitled 'FLY-2654 两项有前置条件的长期授权', restoring the standing carve-out product goal (raya-carrier-follow-main/v1 + lead-closeout-restart/v1 + AUTH-CANON(B) activation manifests) — a different design with an opposite premise. design-correction.md on disk now carries a '最新裁定覆盖前述解释' section stating that ruling 5ac555cf-0161-4373-a403-2d7a35238017 supersedes the two 09-19 rulings this plan is built on, and that '本轮第一稿 39143d02d 及其 request da775f5b-44ce-4004-88a3-8fdb32b88f32 已被替代，不能作为当前设计批准'. This review's verdict is bound to the frozen blob only; it neither approves nor rejects the replacement design, which needs its own round against a newly frozen blob.","failure_scenario":"This round's verdict is carried forward as the design gate for the work that actually lands. The landed design is the standing-carve-out plan, which no reviewer in this round read, so its activation-manifest, confirmer-identity and schemaVersion=3 closeout contract ship ungated.","findingKey":"plan-superseded-midflight"},{"id":"withdrawal-scope-claim-overstated","severity":"MEDIUM","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":39,"title":"§3 claims later withdrawal and scope change are rejected; only same-channel keyword revocation is detected","detail":"The authority.messageRef row asserts '后来撤回/范围变化仍拒绝' with no boundary. restart-request.ts:694-712 only iterates `laterFounderMessages`, which loadRestartRequestContext fetches from a single channel (`authority.messageRef.channelId`), and only fails on a fixed REVOCATION keyword list (撤回|取消|先不要|不要重启|别重启|hold off|cancel|do not restart). A withdrawal in another channel, a DM, or a thread is never seen; a scope change that is not one of those words ('先只重启 Bridge', '我说的是 Raya 那台') is not detected at all. The plan should state the channel scope and the keyword basis as an explicit honest boundary so a later node does not treat this row as a proven scope-drift check.","failure_scenario":"The founder withdraws the restart in the engineering channel while the original instruction sits in a different channel. validateLaterContext sees an empty later-message set, the ticket validates, and the fleet restarts against a withdrawn instruction.","findingKey":"withdrawal-scope-claim-overstated"},{"id":"one-use-exception-undocumented","severity":"MEDIUM","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":44,"title":"One-use invariant omits the implemented zero-side-effect-failure re-prepare exception","detail":"§3 says '更换 requestId、对象、trigger kind、repo 不刷新权限；原子锁与 CAS 保证单次消费' and §5 matrix row 2 says '同一 founder message 换 UUID/trigger/repo 不能重启两次', both unqualified. transitionRestartIntent (restart-request.ts:938-957) implements `replacementAfterZeroSideEffectFailure`: when the prior intent for the same founder channelId/messageId is `failed` with `zeroSideEffects === true`, a NEW requestId and requestDigest may re-enter `prepared`. The behaviour is defensible (the restart provably never happened — update-flywheel.sh marks failed+zeroSideEffects only on the rc82 pre-stop path), but the plan states the opposite invariant, and matrix row 2 as written would pass even if that exception were later widened to cover `failed` without the zeroSideEffects proof.","failure_scenario":"A later change drops the `prior.zeroSideEffects === true` condition so any `failed` intent can be re-prepared. Acceptance matrix row 2 still passes because it only tests a fresh UUID against a live/succeeded intent, and one founder message silently becomes a repeatable restart grant after a failure that did stop services.","findingKey":"one-use-exception-undocumented"},{"id":"acceptance-cmd-wrong-path","severity":"MEDIUM","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":78,"title":"§5's targeted verification command names a test path that does not exist","detail":"The plan gives `pnpm --filter flywheel-teamlead exec vitest run src/__tests__/restart-request.test.ts` as the recorded entry point, attributed to implementation.md. That path does not exist: the suite is at `packages/teamlead/src/bin/restart-request.test.ts` (implementation.md only ever names the bare filename, never the `src/__tests__/` directory). A vitest positional filter matching nothing yields 'No test files found' — this repo has already recorded both halves of that trap (a filter matching nothing, and `pnpm --filter` on a wrong package name exiting 0 with zero tests). Fix the path in the plan so the next implement/QA node cannot copy it verbatim.","failure_scenario":"The next node runs the plan's command verbatim, gets 'No test files found', and either reports a phantom red against unchanged code or — if it reaches for `pnpm --filter` wrappers to work around it — records a zero-test exit-0 pass as evidence that the grammar acceptance matrix still holds.","findingKey":"acceptance-cmd-wrong-path"},{"id":"rc82-not-zero-side-effect","severity":"LOW","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":75,"title":"§5 row 5 calls the rc82 restore path '零服务副作用' without naming the two effects that already fired","detail":"conditional_restart_final_check is correctly mounted before the stop-Bridge boundary (restart-services.sh:3207, before Step 1), and the conditional-restart shell suite proves that placement. But deploy_and_verify has already emitted `notify_routine \"🔄 开始全量重启 Flywheel …\"` at restart-services.sh:3185 and run `pause_admission_best_effort` before reaching the guard. The restore is genuinely stop-free, but not observation-free: a founder-visible 'full restart starting' notice has been published and admission was paused and resumed. §5 row 5 should name these two as the residue, so a QA node checking 'zero side effects' does not read the notice as a guard failure — or conversely read its absence as proof the guard ran.","failure_scenario":"QA validates row 5 by asserting no Discord traffic on an rc82 refusal, sees the '开始全量重启' notice, and either files a false regression or loosens the assertion until it no longer distinguishes a refused wave from a real one.","findingKey":"rc82-not-zero-side-effect"},{"id":"i3-verification-list-incomplete","severity":"LOW","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":65,"title":"§5 I3's targeted-verification list omits guard fixtures this change perturbs","detail":"I3 enumerates verifier, producer, updater source, final guard, trigger policy, plus receipt/budget when rules change. The change also edits four repo-wide guard artifacts: packages/teamlead/src/bridge/child-process-census.json (new sync_child entry for restart-request.ts), scripts/packaged/audit-grep-allowlist.tsv (new hardcoded-repo allowlist row), scripts/lib/path-hygiene.sh source-priority registry (new gh-candidate row), and .github/workflows/ci.yml (conditional-restart.test.sh added to the FLY-1959 job, covered by ci-structure.test.sh). I4 does require CI on the frozen head so this is not a coverage hole, only a late-discovery one; listing them in I3 keeps the failure local.","failure_scenario":"The next node runs only I3's five named suites locally, pushes, and burns a full CI cycle discovering a census or allowlist guard red that a one-minute local run would have caught.","findingKey":"i3-verification-list-incomplete"}],"advisories":[{"id":"plan-superseded-midflight","severity":"MEDIUM","file":"engineering/doc/FLY-2654-lead-standing-authority/plan.md","line":6,"title":"The frozen plan blob was replaced in the working tree during this review round","detail":"The frozen blob 6aed20c (HEAD 39143d02d) is the Part-A-only 'current unconditional instruction' design reviewed here.
